$comment: Repo-owned MCP server definitions (RemEx-56fu.6).
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Between 2026-08-15 and 2026-08-20 the gitnexus and
token-savior entries were wiped out of ~/.claude.json and nobody noticed for
nine days, because ~/.claude/settings.json carries its own 'mcpServers' block
that Claude Code DOES NOT READ. Anyone auditing by opening settings.json - the
obvious thing to do - concluded the servers were configured. Meanwhile CLAUDE.md
still mandated eight tools that could not be called. Version-controlling the
definitions here means the set is reproducible on any machine and any worktree,
and a wipe is a visible diff instead of silence.
THE DEFAULTS ARE CONNOR'S WINDOWS PATHS ON PURPOSE. They are byte-identical to
the user/local-scope entries that are known to work, so if this file's project
scope shadows those, nothing changes. On CachyOS/Linux set the two overrides:
export REMEX_GITNEXUS_BIN=gitnexus
export REMEX_TOKEN_SAVIOR_BIN=$HOME/.venv/bin/token-savior
A bare command name is not used as the Windows default because Node's spawn
does not reliably resolve .cmd shims off PATH - that is why the working config
names gitnexus.cmd in full.
context-mode is deliberately absent: it is a plugin (plugin:context-mode:
context-mode), installed at user scope, not a repo-owned server.
Run scripts/check-mcp-health.ps1 (or .sh) to verify this is actually live.
Claude Code prompts once to approve project-scoped servers; approve both.
